propositions: Code review lacks a dedicated criterion for concurrency race correctness; security and performance overlays do not cover non-attacker and non-load races respectively
The codebase contains four modal production races: detached drain with unlocked git index writes, fsck index.lock TOCTOU reclaim, verify-sign HEAD twice-read drift, and CI bash CAS backoff
A two-tier deterministic lexical trigger (committed high-precision sync-primitive tokens plus project-extensible noisy tier) must differentiate explicitly-synchronized code from unlocked-twin races

Built-in overlay fires only on hunks bearing synchronization primitives (Lock, flock, RwLock) and must not fire on modal unlocked-twin races; project-specific vocabulary in routing config delivers that modal class coverage

Overlay must be registered as advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) pending calibration, with project-extensible trigger mechanism allowing repos to extend vocabulary without code changes
